_comment: OreDictionary decomposer rules. A rule with name applies to that OreDictionary name; a rule with contains applies to the first name that contains that text (the first matching rule wins). tags: item tags read directly (for names with no NeoForge common tag). requires: a setting that must be on. The 4 first rules are the decomposer-only ones; the rest are the same chemicals as synthesisOreRecipes.json.
